independence_declaration.statement: I am domain-reviewer, run T-DG1-REV-DOM-R7. I did not author any implementation, register text or decision in the DG1 scope, and I did not author the round-7 repairs: the F-DG1-127 lint change is backend-workflow-engineer work (T-DG1-BE8), and the F-DG1-212 log regeneration is orchestrator-owned. I formed this verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-7 record, and none was visible to me. The only earlier review material I used was my own round-6 domain-reviewer record and harness scripts (re-used here as round-7 copies), plus the findings.json status entries for the findings my assignment names. I grant no business, Finance or IT approval. Product gate G6 is not engineering gate DG7.

checks_run.procedure: Confirm the frozen candidate before reviewing. Check HEAD, that the repository is not shallow, the recomputed candidate id and its --diff against the frozen manifest, and that every difference between HEAD and the freeze commit is candidate-excluded metadata. Make a disposable full clone at the freeze commit, recompute the id there, and check that pnpm-lock.yaml matches.
checks_run.command: git rev-parse HEAD; git rev-parse --is-shallow-repository; git diff --stat a6bdea0 HEAD; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG1; node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG1 --diff; git clone /home/user/My-owns $TMPDIR/review-dom7 && git checkout a6bdea0 && node tools/gates/candidate.mjs --stage DG1 && cmp pnpm-lock.yaml
checks_run.environment: Linux sandbox, node v22, pnpm 10; candidate tree /home/user/My-owns and a disposable clone under $TMPDIR (removed afterwards)
checks_run.expected: The recomputed id is sha256:d3743a35...9c68c47649ab7. HEAD is the freeze commit, or a descendant that changes only candidate-excluded metadata.
checks_run.actual: HEAD is 2cfbf4f ('DG1 r7: freeze candidate d3743a35 + round-7 review assignments'), a direct child of the freeze commit a6bdea0. Its diff touches only the round-7 assignments, the candidate manifest and stages.json, all candidate-excluded. The repository is not shallow. The working tree and the clone at a6bdea0 both recompute sha256:d3743a352912a357b0a81124794561cea5f06f5dbc31542b9623c68c47649ab7 over 390 files, and --diff reports matches=true with nothing added, removed or changed. pnpm-lock.yaml is byte-identical. HEAD differs from source_commit only by metadata, which review-common.md anticipates.

Confirm that apps/api/tsconfig.build.json excludes *.testkit.ts and *.test.ts, and that the built dist has no architecture file.

':!docs/delivery'; git diff --stat 0026a7b a6bdea0 -- apps/web apps/worker packages docs/api docs/architecture docs/source apps/api ':!apps/api/src/architecture.test.ts' ':!apps/api/src/architecture.testkit.ts'; git diff --stat 0026a7b a6bdea0 -- docs/delivery/requirements.csv docs/delivery/decisions.md; cat apps/api/tsconfig.build.json; find apps/api/dist -iname '*architecture*' | wc -l

checks_run.expected: Only architecture.test.ts and architecture.testkit.ts changed. The runtime-surface diff is empty, and dist has no architecture file.

Focused run: 4 files, 99/99 tests, exit 0. architecture.test.ts has 78 tests, which matches D-053's 78/78, with 'A1 node:sqlite loadExtension is a violation', X6 and P12 passing, the six-module A12 test, 'cursor round-trips and is bound to the filter hash' and 'paginates limit+1 rows'. i18n run: 19/19 tests, exit 0.

checks_run.procedure: Check that the F-DG1-127 fix does not over-reach, using a reviewer-authored probe on the candidate's own testkit. (a) Every bare specifier the real module tree imports (collected with the lint's own importsOf AST scanner), 12 ordinary node: built-ins, the four @mth shared packages and every third-party api dependency must stay allowed (47 in total). (b) Differential test: copy the round-6 testkit (git show 0026a7b) into the clone and compare bareAllowed verdicts over a 108-specifier corpus (real tree, all ~42 Node built-ins with and without node:, sqlite3/better-sqlite3/sqlite subpaths, shared packages, dependencies). The only change may be the sqlite ban. (c) All 9 import routes of the sqlite module must be violations. (d) The real module tree must have 0 violations, and a global process.env read must still pass. Run 1 of the probe expected both 'sqlite' and 'node:sqlite' to flip. That was a probe bug: a bare non-node: specifier was already rejected in round 6 unless it is a declared api dependency. Run 1 output is kept as 03-f127-overreach-probe.run1-probe-bug.out.txt, and the expectation was corrected for run 2.
checks_run.command: git show 0026a7b:apps/api/src/architecture.testkit.ts > apps/api/src/zz-r6.testkit.ts; cp 03-f127-overreach-probe.test.ts apps/api/src/zz-dom7-probe.test.ts; npx vitest run --project unit-node --reporter=verbose apps/api/src/zz-dom7-probe.test.ts; rm both probe files
checks_run.environment: Disposable clone at a6bdea0; vitest unit-node project
checks_run.expected: (a) 0 rejected; (b) only node:sqlite/sqlite verdicts change; (c) 0 missed; (d) 0 violations
checks_run.actual: Run 2: 4/4 PASS, exit 0. (a) 47 legitimate specifiers were checked and none was rejected. (b) Over the 108-specifier corpus the only verdict change is 'node:sqlite: r6=true r7=false', and both sqlite spellings are now rejected. Nothing else is newly rejected, including every other node: built-in (fs, crypto, wasi, test, ...). (c) 9 forms tested (named, bare-sqlite, namespace, default, side-effect, require, dynamic import, named and star re-export), missed: []. (d) Real module tree violations: 0, and the global process.env read gives []. The production source has no sqlite reference outside the two lint files, and ADR-0003 fixes persistence on PostgreSQL. The ban removes no capability any module uses. It is a test-only, build-excluded, defence-in-depth lint with no user-facing effect.

checks_run.procedure: Read the testkit header and D-053, and check that the stated and accepted residuals honestly describe a static defence-in-depth lint. The text must not claim a runtime security boundary, must not over-claim exhaustiveness, and must not describe a user-facing change.
checks_run.command: git diff 108e997 a6bdea0 -- apps/api/src/architecture.testkit.ts; grep '| D-053 |' docs/delivery/decisions.md
checks_run.environment: Repository at HEAD 2cfbf4f (files identical to a6bdea0)
checks_run.expected: Residuals are scoped, explicitly accepted and honest. There is no claim of exhaustive coverage or a runtime boundary, and no product-behaviour change.
checks_run.actual: The header lists residuals (a) runtime data flow into third-party key reads, (b) runtime code generation followed by a literal same-module dynamic import (node:fs deliberately not banned), and (c) an enumerated denylist that cannot be proven exhaustive (a future built-in, WebAssembly). It says plainly that the lint is 'NOT a runtime security boundary'. D-053 repeats this and adds a reopen trigger: a demonstrated native route that is not a stated residual is closed like sqlite. This is an honest statement of a lint's limits, not a user-facing change. Minor wording note, not a finding: D-053's evidence column lists 'the round-7 freeze + its three PASS reviews + auditor' prospectively, as the evidence the decision expects, not as a claim that they already exist.

summary: PASS. Candidate d3743a35 confirmed (freeze a6bdea0; HEAD 2cfbf4f adds only metadata). Since round 6 only the module lint and its self-test changed, and both are excluded from the build. There is no product, runtime, API, data-model or i18n change. The F-DG1-127 ban does not over-reach: across 108 specifiers the only verdict change from the round-6 lint is node:sqlite, 47 legitimate specifiers stay allowed, and the real module tree has 0 violations. The residuals stated in the testkit header and in D-053 honestly describe a defence-in-depth lint. There is no domain regression: 271/271 unit tests, 2 x 200/200 integration runs with no leftovers, and 108/108 live checks in ar and en. These cover the G6 closure refused with 422, scoped access, cursor binding, identity routes, provisional branding, Unknown shown instead of zero, and the localized audit. All 12 round-6 domain closures still hold. The register is unchanged and the 8 assigned rows are IMPLEMENTED with all evidence present. No new findings.
